caption: The import dialog's layer-assignment section gains an 'Assign layer types by clicking the geometry…' button above the number fields.
The picker opens with the top cell's geometry color-coded per layer, a legend below, and disabled type buttons until something is clicked.
Clicking the long route on the unknown foundry layer selects (37,0): it highlights while the other layers dim, and the type buttons enable.
Pressing 'Waveguide' assigns the selected layer; the legend row flips from '—' to 'waveguide'.
Back in the import dialog the waveguide layer field already carries 37,0 — no layer numbers were typed or guessed.
